scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --config oxlint.config.mjs scripts packages/*/src packages/*/test apps/*/src apps/*/test
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --config oxlint.config.mjs --fix scripts packages/*/src packages/*/test apps/*/src apps/*/test
scripts.format: oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.mjs --check scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.scripts.json vitest.config.ts && bun run --filter '*' format
scripts.format:fix: oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.mjs scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.scripts.json vitest.config.ts && bun run --filter '*' format:fix
scripts.test: vitest run scripts && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format && bun run ast-grep && bun run ast-grep:test && bun run test
